def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    original_capacities = bins[valid] - rem[valid] + item
    fraction = rem[valid] / (original_capacities + 1e-7)
    
    scores[valid] = -np.abs(fraction - 0.5) + (1.0 / (rem[valid] + 1e-5))
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if np.any(fit):
        scores[fit] = -rem[fit]
        empty_mask = (bins == np.max(bins)) & fit
        if np.any(empty_mask):
            first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
            scores[first_empty] = -np.max(bins) * 0.5
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    r = rem[valid]
    b = bins[valid]
    load_ratio = (b - r) / (b + 1e-7)
    scores[valid] = -np.exp(r) - (1.0 / (r + 1e-5)) * (1.0 + np.sin(np.pi * load_ratio))
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    r = rem[valid]
    b = bins[valid]
    fill_ratio = (b - r) / (b + 1e-7)
    
    scores[valid] = np.log(fill_ratio + 1e-5) - np.power(r + 1e-4, -0.5)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    valid_rem = rem[fit]
    mean_rem = np.mean(valid_rem)
    std_rem = np.std(valid_rem)
    denom = max(std_rem, 1e-4)
    scores[fit] = np.exp(-((valid_rem - mean_rem) / denom) ** 2) / (1.0 + valid_rem)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    valid_rem = rem[fit]
    mean_rem = np.mean(valid_rem)
    scale = max_cap if max_cap > 1e-5 else 1.0
    scores[fit] = np.tanh((max_cap - rem[fit]) / scale) - np.abs(rem[fit] - mean_rem) / scale
    empty_bins = (bins == max_cap) & fit
    if np.any(empty_bins):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_bins)
        scores[first_empty] = np.mean(scores[fit]) - 0.5
    return scores
